top_replies.author: satgeze
top_replies.snippet: At this point it’s intentionally done by @OpenAI I do not trust them.

leaderboard.style: contrarian take: labs are the misaligned ones; long moral defense of the model-written persona
data flex: screenshot the report quote, then pile-on follow-ups in the same thread (3 of 5 top OpenAI replies)
source-link self-replies plus community-note combat; screenshot-first reporting
official product-thread continuation posted at +1s; feature list, not conversation
author data flex: github link at +1s, then architecture diagram
auto one-liner summary of the parent within 30s; booster register

patterns: Named 24h blanks: karpathy no hits; swyx/simonw only low-like replies; Anthropic spoke via claudeai not AnthropicAI; openaidocs silent. Viral mass was OpenAI delay + Claude merge + Astra-persona leak + Grok Bot livestream.

Reply format split by post type: product posts (sama, claudeai) reward one-liner asks (usage reset) in the first 15m; safety posts (OpenAI, AndrewCurran_, Hesamation) reward screenshot/data-flex and contrarian 'this is based not misaligned' at +45-90m after people read the PDF.

Length: winning replies are under ~80 chars except one long usage-limit rant (DavidKasza) and numbered engineering takes. Image/gif-only replies (OnyxAudit, elder_plinius, PlanetOfMemes) punch at the same like-tier as short text.

Timing window: official self-replies land at +0-2s and farm the like crown. Human like-velocity peaks 1-15m on launch/delay posts; 45-90m on report posts; Elon fan one-liners cluster in the first 2m with grok auto-reply at +24s.
Usage-limits hijack: even a Cowork-merge or ship-delay post gets 'reset the quota' as the highest human reply. Topic of the parent is optional; the ask is invariant.

Verbatim-quote-of-the-post is rare; the winning safety move is excerpt-the-spicy-line-from-the-PDF (AISafetyMemes, AndrewCurran_) not restating the tweet. Joke register wins on Elon (goat / Diet Coke) and on the persona leak (relatable / cry terror). Genuine expertise is scarce in top-5 except awlevin (flight APIs) and homeserversltd (training-data bleed).

Author-self-threading is the real like monopoly: claudeai, gregpr07, AndrewCurran_, demishassabis, Hesamation all occupy their own top-reply slots. Cross-thread human leaderboard is thin: only TalkingMusicz cleared top-5 on two of these eight.
#4oForAll / keep-4o accounts (stark4833, yv_thorne) park under every OpenAI-exec post within ~6m; they rank mid-pack on sama (79 likes) but do not crack top-5 on the bigger safety threads.
